page.overview:
Who is Kata Akuna?

Kata Akuna was a human female who was the daughter of Bode and Tayala Akuna.

The Akuna family lived happily on the Inner Rim world of Birren. One day, Kata was out with Bode when they received a comm message from Tayala saying to flee with Kata because the Inquisitorius had found them. Bode took Kata to the Nova Garon system and struck a deal with an ISB commander and chief supervisor named Lank Denvik, his former handler in Republic Intelligence. Bode was to act on behalf of Denvik in order to keep Kata safe from the Inquisitorius. One such mission required Bode to gain the trust of Jedi Knight Cal Kestis in order to infiltrate the anti-Imperial operations of Saw Gerrera. While with Kestis, Bode learned of a hidden planet called Tanalorr, which the Empire was unaware of due to it being blocked by the Koboh Abyss.

While her father served Commander Denvik, Kata remained in the officers' quarters on the ISB station, spending significant time alone with her doll Mookie. She quickly developed a hatred for the base while living there.

Bode eventually betrayed Kestis, and stole from him a compass which served as the last remaining key to navigate the Koboh Abyss and reach Tanalorr. With Kestis in pursuit, Bode fled back to Nova Garon to fetch Kata. As her father implemented a plan to betray Denvik to the Inquisitorius and erase any record of him or Kata, the girl met Kestis, who had infiltrated the base. Kestis attempted to win the child's trust by helping Kata find Mookie who had been lost in the living quarters. Bode managed to distract Kestis and buy time for him and Kata to escape the ISB station.
